text.arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّرِيدٍۢ

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating opening that carries the prior scene into a new diagnostic case
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation rather than a clean reset. It carries the prior corrective disclosure forward and lets the next words introduce a human type as an added diagnostic case, with the bound written form making that continuation visible at the surface.

topics.headline: continuation that launches a diagnostic type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts as a continuation of the previous scene while opening a new human diagnostic profile.
topics.reason: The particle is the opening conjunction of the ayah, and the local clause structure begins a partitive nominal frame after the prior ayah boundary.

topics.headline: bound connective surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuation not only in discourse function but in the visible bound form attached to the next word.
topics.reason: The written opening joins the conjunction directly to the following preposition, so the surface form itself supports the continuation payoff.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition selecting a subset from a known human field, with source and among senses jointly active
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) starts the partitive frame. It makes the coming figure emerge from a known human field rather than appear as an isolated outsider, and its fronted position lets the collective field be heard before the individual type is named.

topics.headline: subset extracted from a human field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputer is extracted from humanity, so the profile is internal to the human field rather than alien to it.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the definite people noun and forms the fronted partitive construction before the relative selector.

topics.headline: fronting delays the archetype
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: the human mass is placed first, and only then does the anonymous representative emerge.
topics.reason: The local syntax fronts the prepositional phrase before the relative pronoun, preserving the delayed-subject effect.

words.gloss_range: the definite human collective as governed source-set from which one representative type is selected
words.root_gloss_range: humanity as a relational and perceptible class, with a contested forgetfulness pressure preserved only as lexical background

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: partitive people-selector formula introducing an anonymous representative type
contested forgetfulness derivation preserved only as background pressure

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) is definite and genitive, so the word does not introduce humanity from nowhere; it supplies the governed source-set for the coming selector. Its collective form lets one anonymous member carry the diagnosis while the wider human field remains present, and the contested derivation keeps two human pressures visible: sociable perception from {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) and forgetfulness from {{ar:ن س ي}} ({{tr:n-s-y}}). The formula {{ar:مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَنْ}} ({{tr:mina al-nāsi man}}) introduces anonymous archetypes elsewhere too (2:8, 2:200, 31:6).

topics.headline: known people as governed source-set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are a known collective field governed by the partitive phrase, not a newly introduced universal subject.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive after the partitive preposition, matching the source-set claim.

topics.headline: sociability and forgetfulness background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human collective carries relational and contested forgetfulness pressure, while local grammar still selects the ordinary people noun.
topics.reason: The root and derivational rows provide valid lexical pressure, but the local noun remains the governed people collective rather than a separate claim about forgetting.

topics.headline: collective-to-representative formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from a known collective to an anonymous representative type, a recurring formula for behavioral diagnosis.
topics.reason: The sequence places the collective noun before the singular relative selector and matches the row's formulaic archetype claim.

words.gloss_range: open relative selector, delayed subject of the partitive frame, defining an anonymous type by the predicates that follow
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) withholds a name and opens a slot: whoever fits the coming verbs belongs to the type. As the delayed subject of the fronted partitive frame, it completes the movement from collective humanity into one accountable representative, and it governs both predicate movements that follow.

topics.headline: anonymous relative selector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines a type rather than identifying a named individual.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun has no named antecedent and its following predicates define the open reference.

topics.headline: delayed subject governing both predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammatical hinge: the same anonymous subject carries both disputing and following.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence routes the relative pronoun as subject of the first verb, and coordination carries the same subject into the second predicate.

topics.headline: unmarked for gender and number
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun form resists narrowing the type by visible gender or number marking.
topics.reason: The local surface form is the indeclinable relative pronoun, while the following masculine singular verbs instantiate the grammatical profile.

words.gloss_range: ongoing reciprocal disputation, scoped about God and qualified by lack of knowledge rather than taking a direct object
words.root_gloss_range: contention and disputation with twisting, braiding, and tightened adversarial pressure; the local Form III imperfect selects engaged polemic
words.prose: {{ar:يُجَٰدِلُ}} ({{tr:yujādilu}}) is the first predicate of the anonymous type. Its imperfect form makes disputing an ongoing trait, and its frame gives the dispute a domain and a lack-of-knowledge qualifier rather than a direct object. The root's twisting and Form III reciprocity make the act feel like active entanglement in claims, not neutral questioning.

topics.headline: ongoing intransitive dispute with two complements
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb defines a continuing habit of the same anonymous subject, with topic and manner supplied by following complements.
topics.reason: The verb instance is imperfect 3ms, has the relative pronoun as subject, and takes prepositional complements rather than a direct object.

topics.headline: root twisting and Form III reciprocity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dispute as reciprocal, tightened polemic; the root image colors the act without replacing the local disputation sense.
topics.reason: The local Form III imperfect licenses reciprocal disputation, while concrete derivatives such as braiding or hawk imagery remain background pressure rather than the selected local sense.

topics.headline: marked dispute-about-God formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not an isolated verb choice but an archetypal dispute-about-God pattern that returns with an expanded lack-list in 22:8.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete recurrence references, and the local phrase contains the same dispute-domain-lack structure.

topics.headline: intellectual failure before allegiance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's order: cognitive contention appears before the following clause names behavioral allegiance.
topics.reason: The first relative clause begins with this verb and is completed before the coordinated following predicate.

words.gloss_range: topical preposition marking the domain of disputation, with spatial containment residue kept as rhetorical pressure
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the following divine name the domain of dispute, not a direct object of the verb. The particle works topically here, while its ordinary sense of being in a domain gives the contention a contained topic-space before the lack-of-knowledge phrase arrives.

topics.headline: domain of disputation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dispute is placed within a topic-domain rather than aimed at a direct grammatical object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the divine name the governed complement of the preposition attached to the dispute verb.

topics.headline: spatial residue under topical use
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a topic-space effect, while local syntax blocks treating the particle as causal here.
topics.reason: The local construction selects topical concerning; spatial containment remains image-pressure, while a causal reading would misassign the relation.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name as the specific governed domain of dispute, not a generic deity category
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field involving worship, devotion, and bewilderment; local surface fixes the proper name as referent
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is governed by the topical preposition, so the named divine referent is the domain of contention. Because the word is the proper name, the dispute is not about an indefinite deity category. The worship and bewilderment background sharpens the irony: bewilderment before God is not condemned, but ungrounded contention about the named divine referent is.

topics.headline: proper divine name as dispute domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dispute concerns the known proper divine name, not a generic theological category.
topics.reason: The noun is a proper noun in genitive after the topical preposition, with dominant referent evidence identifying God.

topics.headline: bewilderment and devotion background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the divine-name field can include bewilderment and devotion, while the local clause condemns contention without knowledge.
topics.reason: The derivational material supplies background pressure, but the local proper noun remains the selected divine name rather than an abstract act of bewilderment.

topics.headline: divine name within dispute-knowledge-adversary network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name sits at the center of dispute, knowledge-lack, and adversarial-following relations in the local movement.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence supports the local compression of dispute, knowledge, and adversarial fields around the divine name.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking accompanying circumstance or manner for the privative lack-of-knowledge phrase
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) binds the lack phrase to the disputing as its accompanying condition. The local force is not a flat instrument but a circumstantial manner: the contention travels with absence of knowledge, and the phrase closes the first predicate before the coordinated following begins.

topics.headline: circumstantial lack qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge-lack accompanies and qualifies the dispute rather than functioning as a simple instrument.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the privative phrase a complement to the disputing verb, and translation support warns against a purely instrumental reading.

topics.headline: bound privative unit before coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lack phrase is a governed unit sealing the first predicate, while it can still pressure the behavioral clause that follows.
topics.reason: The phrase is syntactically attached to the first predicate; any extension over the second predicate is a discourse pressure, not a forced grammatical attachment.

words.gloss_range: privative construct head meaning without or other-than, dependent on the following indefinite knowledge noun
words.root_gloss_range: otherness, change, and alteration; local construct selects privation rather than an active process of changing
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرِ}} ({{tr:ghayri}}) is the hinge of the privative construction. It does not stand as an independent abstract noun here; it governs the following knowledge noun and converts the dispute into a diagnosis of absence. The otherness and change field survives as pressure: the speaker is positioned away from the epistemic norm, not shown actively changing something. The same privative frame later shifts from absence of knowledge to absence of right (22:40), so this exclusion marker begins a local thread.

topics.headline: without-knowledge construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the absence is built as a compact construct phrase, with knowledge as the missing criterion.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and first term of an iḍāfa with the following indefinite knowledge noun.

topics.headline: otherness as epistemic deviation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that privation is felt as otherness from knowledge, while local form blocks reading an active changing event.
topics.reason: The nominal construct supports privation and otherness; active changing derivatives remain lexical background.

topics.headline: recurring exclusion formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as part of a broader privative pattern that later shifts from lack of knowledge to lack of right in 22:40.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete local recurrence of the privative construction, and the local grammar matches that construction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite knowledge as the absent epistemic criterion inside the privative construct
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing, sign, marker, and learned formation; local phrase denies epistemic grounding rather than naming an act of knowing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular indefinite adversarial class noun under universal quantification
genitive indefinite qualitative adjective marking stripped-rebellious quality

words.prose: {{ar:عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿilmin}}) names the missing criterion. Because it is indefinite inside the privative phrase, the lack is not of one specified item but of epistemic grounding as such. The root's sign and marker field makes the absence sharper: the dispute proceeds without the mark that would distinguish valid claim from invalid claim. Its final tanwīn cadence links the missing knowledge to {{ar:شَيْطَٰنٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayṭānin}}) and {{ar:مَّرِيدٍۢ}} ({{tr:marīdin}}), so lack, adversary, and qualifier are bound audibly.

topics.headline: indefinite knowledge under privative scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge is grammatically the absent criterion, not an object of the dispute.
topics.reason: The word is the indefinite genitive complement of the privative construct.

topics.headline: knowledge as marker and formation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing knowledge is also missing a marker or learned formation, while the local sense remains knowledge itself.
topics.reason: The root field supports sign and learning pressure, but local grammar selects the knowledge noun within the privative phrase.

topics.headline: divine-knowledge pairing locally negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a strong God-knowledge pairing is locally inverted: the dispute concerns God precisely without knowledge.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence supports the God-knowledge pairing, and the local privative construction turns that expected relation into absence.

topics.headline: audible link to later adversarial phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lack of knowledge is audibly and structurally linked to the adversarial object that follows.
topics.reason: The privative opposition is local, and the tanwīn cadence recurs in the later adversarial phrase.

words.gloss_range: medial coordinating conjunction binding the second predicate to the same anonymous subject and pivoting from knowledge-lack to allegiance
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second imperfect to the first under the same anonymous subject. The conjunction is not a restart; it binds intellectual failure to behavioral allegiance, so the following action becomes part of one profile rather than a separate sentence.

topics.headline: second predicate under same subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same person who disputes is also the one who follows.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second verb with the first and keeps both inside the same relative profile.

topics.headline: pivot from lack to following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's turn from disputing without knowledge to allegiance to every rebellious adversary.
topics.reason: The conjunction comes immediately after the privative phrase and before the second imperfect, creating the local pivot.

words.gloss_range: ongoing deliberate following or adopted allegiance, taking the totalized adversarial class as direct object
words.root_gloss_range: following after, compliance, imitation, retinue, and consequence or liability; local Form VIII emphasizes volitional self-attachment
words.prose: {{ar:يَتَّبِعُ}} ({{tr:yattabiʿu}}) gives the second half of the profile: the same subject who disputes also follows. Its direct object is the totalized adversarial class, and the Form VIII shape makes the following sound like adopted allegiance rather than accidental movement. The variant spectrum usefully exposes the agency pressure, from simple following to deliberate adherence or causing others to follow, but the local canonical form keeps the focus on deliberate self-attachment. The next ayah answers this allegiance with turning and misguidance (22:4).

topics.headline: same actor follows the totalized object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following is a second ongoing predicate of the same actor and takes the totalized adversarial phrase as object.
topics.reason: The verb is an imperfect 3ms predicate coordinated with the first verb, with the following quantifier phrase as explicit object.

topics.headline: Form VIII deliberate following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following is volitional allegiance with consequence, while broader root derivatives remain background pressure.
topics.reason: The local form is read as Form VIII and the verb takes an explicit object; retinue and liability derivatives color the selected following sense without replacing it.

topics.headline: variant agency spectrum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that small form changes would shift agency from simple following to deliberate adherence or causing others to follow, while the local form remains deliberate following.
topics.reason: The variant rows are useful as accepted-form contrast, but they do not replace the aligned canonical surface in this output.

topics.headline: behavioral result of epistemic failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's complete profile: ungrounded contention becomes adopted allegiance, and 22:4 answers that allegiance with misguidance.
topics.reason: The coordinated imperfects share the same subject, and the CRITICAL rows provide the concrete next-ayah consequence reference.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct quantifier making the adversarial object distributively total
words.root_gloss_range: totality, completeness, encompassing, and encircling; local construct functions as a universal quantifier over the following indefinite noun
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) turns the object of following into distributive totality. It is accusative as the object head and construct-bound to the following indefinite noun, so the phrase does not mean a vague adversarial field but every instance one by one. The enclosing crown or circle image in the root background sharpens this as no-gap scope, while the local construction keeps it functioning as a quantifier. This totality also answers the earlier knowledge void: no knowledge is matched by every rebellious adversary, and the totality root crosses from universal terror in 22:2 to universal adversarial allegiance here.

topics.headline: distributive universal object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality itself is built into the direct object of following.
topics.reason: The word is accusative as object of the following verb and first term of an iḍāfa with the following indefinite noun.

topics.headline: no-gap totality image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the no-gap, each-instance force of the quantifier, while the crown or circle image remains lexical pressure.
topics.reason: The local construction licenses universal quantification; encompassing imagery colors that force without becoming an independent referent.

topics.headline: absence answered by universal following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural movement from no knowledge to every adversary, making vacancy become indiscriminate allegiance.
topics.reason: The privative phrase closes the first predicate and the universal object opens the second predicate, supporting the structural pairing.

topics.headline: totality inverted from terror to allegiance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality crosses from the prior scene's universal exposure to this ayah's universal adversarial following.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the 22:2 to 22:3 boundary contrast, and the local word supplies the totality term in the second setting.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite adversarial class noun under universal quantification, qualified by the following adjective
words.root_gloss_range: distance, opposition, adversarial remoteness, and devil or rebellious being; local quantifier favors an adversarial class reading over a single named being
words.prose: {{ar:شَيْطَٰنٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayṭānin}}) is singular and indefinite under the universal quantifier, so it names any instance of the adversarial class rather than one specified figure. The distance and opposition root pressure makes the object of following a remoteness from truth or good, and the following adjective is locked to every instance in that class. This followed object later returns in the surah as an acting inserter and test element (22:52-53), so the early object of allegiance becomes a later agent.

topics.headline: any adversarial instance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase universalizes a class of adversarial instances rather than naming one devil.
topics.reason: The noun is singular indefinite and genitive as the complement of the universal construct.

topics.headline: distance and opposition over demon-only narrowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the term names adversarial remoteness from good, while local grammar does not require a demon-only narrowing.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports distance and opposition pressure, and the universal indefinite construction keeps the object field broad.

topics.headline: qualified concrete class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following adjective is not floating; it qualifies every adversarial instance included by the quantifier.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with this noun in genitive and indefiniteness, while occurrence data treats the term as a concrete noun class.

topics.headline: followed object later appears as actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the adversarial figure followed here later appears in the surah as an acting inserter in 22:52.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete later references, and the local word supplies the early followed-object position.

words.gloss_range: genitive indefinite qualitative adjective marking each adversarial instance as stripped-rebellious
words.root_gloss_range: smoothness, bareness, stripping, and rebellion; local faʿīl adjective selects a durable rebellious quality rather than an actor noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite knowledge as the absent epistemic criterion
singular indefinite adversarial class noun under universal quantification

words.prose: {{ar:مَّرِيدٍۢ}} ({{tr:marīdin}}) closes the ayah by specifying the quality of the followed adversary. Its agreement locks the adjective to every adversarial instance under the universal quantifier, while the root's smoothness and bareness field makes rebellion feel like being stripped of restraining good; the polished-surface image in 27:44 helps sharpen that texture. The faʿīl pattern makes this a durable state, not a single rebellious act, contrasting the actor pattern in 37:7 and pairing with the rare adjective use in 4:117. Its final tanwīn also completes the audible chain after {{ar:عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿilmin}}) and {{ar:شَيْطَٰنٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayṭānin}}).

topics.headline: qualifier attached to every adversary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing quality applies to every adversarial instance, not to one named rebel.
topics.reason: The adjective is genitive and indefinite, agreeing with the preceding noun inside the universal object phrase.

topics.headline: stripped bareness as moral rebellion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rebellion as a stripped or smoothed moral texture, while local syntax keeps the word functioning as an adjective.
topics.reason: The root field supports smoothness and bareness pressure, but the local form is the qualitative adjective modifying the adversarial noun.

topics.headline: durable quality rather than actor identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on a stable rebellious quality, with 37:7 contrasting an actor pattern and 4:117 sharing the rare adjective.
topics.reason: The local form is a qualitative adjective with low occurrence, and the cited contrasts clarify state versus actor without replacing the local reading.

topics.headline: rare qualifier seals the profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word seals the diagnosis by stacking universal scope, adversarial class, and rare stripped-rebellious quality.
topics.reason: The adjective is the final word of the ayah and completes the quantified adversarial phrase with a rare qualitative form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated verbs يُجَٰدِلُ and يَتَّبِعُ, with بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ between them.
baseline_models.mechanism: A verbal contest twists assertion against assertion while excluding disclosed knowledge and its distinguishing marks. The same subject then follows rather than verifies; كُلَّ makes that receptivity exhaustive, and شَيْطَٰنٍ مَّرِيدٍ identifies the followed sources as rebellious and stripped of good.

activation_trace.role: Entwined verbal contest supplies speech that loops against an opponent and functions as the subject's apparent epistemic activity.
Exclusion and negation make knowledge absent from the contest rather than merely incomplete.
Disclosure to a knower is the missing constraint that could test the contest's claims.
Following behind and imitating turns the subject's supposedly active dispute into derivative conduct.
Comprehensive inclusion makes the following indiscriminate across every available rebellious source.
The overbearing rebel supplies the class of agents whose direction substitutes for knowledge.
Being stripped of good until hardened in rebellion intensifies the followed source's settled resistance.

changed_reading.before: An uninformed person argues about God and also imitates devils.
changed_reading.after: The argument is part of the following mechanism: with knowledge excluded, rival verbal pressure becomes direction, so the apparent independent disputant is comprehensively derivative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يُجَٰدِلُ ... يَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍ links roots whose inventories include twisting, trailing, long cord, distance, and encirclement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The contest can be modeled materially as a tightly braided tether. Following moves along that tether after distant forces; totality turns one cord into an encircling system, while the smooth or stripped quality of مَرِيد suggests reduced grip for resistance.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the braid and functions as the material organization of the dispute.
Trailing behind supplies motion along the braided line rather than autonomous route choice.
A long strongly twisted cord makes the tether image internal to the focus root inventory.
Distance and severance supply the trajectory toward remoteness.
Something surrounding like a crown turns plural susceptibility into encirclement.
A polished smooth surface supplies a low-friction quality to the tether's rebellious guide.

changed_reading.before: Debating and following are two adjacent bad actions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, argumentative braiding makes the very tether by which the subject is drawn after increasingly remote influences; speaking and capture are one material circuit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ, بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ, and يَتَّبِعُ attach human perception and sociability to absent marks and stepwise pursuit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human root inventory carries seeing, sensing, hearing, and companionship. Knowledge can be a mark that distinguishes and guides, yet here that mark is absent; the human capacity to perceive and find company inverts into tracing alienating influences step after step.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving by sight, sensation, or hearing supplies the human faculty that should register evidence.
Companionship that removes estrangement supplies the social pull that is being redirected.
A distinguishing mark that guides is precisely what the construction says the subject lacks.
Tracing one mark after another supplies a failed search procedure captured by the wrong trail.
Distance and severance make the resulting companionship alienating rather than familiarizing.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies a morally bad member of humanity.
changed_reading.after: It depicts an inversion of human capacities: perception without a reliable mark and sociability without discernment become stepwise attachment to what increases distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ت ب ع in يَتَّبِعُ carries both pursuit of a claim and a consequence that remains attached.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following can establish more than imitation: it can bring a claimant and an attached consequence behind the follower. كُلَّ multiplies those claims, while the surrounding dispute gives the relation a contested, consequential field.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit of a right or claim supplies a claimant-like relation inside following.
An attached liability supplies the consequence that trails the follower.
Comprehensive totality multiplies the attached claims across every followed source.
Contested speech supplies the arena in which allegiance appears cost-free while accruing consequences.

changed_reading.before: Following means copying a rebellious leader.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each allegiance creates a trailing claim: the follower accumulates the liabilities of every direction he adopts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two preceding ayat stage violent shaking, failed attention to a nursing bond, release of every pregnancy, and people who look intoxicated without intoxicant. The focus subject's no-knowledge argument and exhaustive following can therefore be read as a disoriented response inside a field where perception and primary attachments have come loose.

activation_trace.role: Human sensing and seeing anchor the changed reading in the focus subject's perceptual capacity.
Missing disclosure names the focus failure produced within the surrounding perceptual crisis.
Violent disturbance supplies the environmental unsteadiness that precedes the focus conduct.
Attention departing from its object supplies cognitive unfastening.
A nursing relation equivalent to kinship supplies the primary attachment from which attention is torn.
The inner carried burden being released supplies bodily loss of containment.
Loss of sobriety or its likeness supplies impaired appearance while the explicit negation prevents a simple substance explanation.
Repeated comprehensive totality anticipates the focus ayah's كُلَّ and transfers universal disruption into universal susceptibility.

structural_cues: 22:1-2 immediately precede the focus ayah.
22:2 repeats both الناس and كل before 22:3 repeats them in a new behavioral configuration.
The contrast سكارى وما هم بسكارى distinguishes disoriented appearance from literal intoxication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies environmental shaking, severed attention, released burdens, and altered appearance; I infer that 22:3 presents one epistemic-social response under that pressure. A live alternative is that 22:1-2 remain only eschatological background and do not causally profile the disputant.

changed_reading.before: The disputant calmly chooses bad argument and bad company.
changed_reading.after: The disputant is also a figure of unmoored perception: under total destabilization, lost epistemic grip is converted into indiscriminate attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel gives following a rule-like trajectory: a consequence is written upon the rebellious agent, and whoever enters his patronal proximity is misdirected and then 'guided' toward punishment. Following thus transfers practical direction to a guide whose route is already fixed.

activation_trace.role: Following behind anchors the transfer of route control in the focus verb.
The rebellious agent supplies the immediate antecedent whose governing effect the sequel unfolds.
An established writing that obliges a judgment supplies the fixed consequence of the relation.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the patronal transfer embedded in تولاه.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the first leg of the assigned route.
Gentle direction toward a road is used with an adverse destination, exposing guidance as a formally neutral directional capacity.

structural_cues: 22:4 is the immediate syntactic sequel to the focus ayah.
Singular pronouns carry forward the shaytan-follower relation.
The paired verbs يضله ويهديه specify process and destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an obligatory writing, patronal proximity, misdirection, and directed arrival; I infer that following delegates practical guidance. A live alternative is that تولاه foregrounds the human's chosen allegiance more than the shaytan's acquired control.

changed_reading.before: The person copies a rebel's behavior.
changed_reading.after: The person appoints a directional patron and enters a preassigned itinerary: allegiance hands over route selection, including the route's destructive destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim recurrence in 22:8 expands بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ into a threefold lack: knowledge, guidance, and an illuminating book. The next ayah embodies that lack as a turned side and gives it a social vector, misleading others from a path. Ignorance becomes active refusal of orienting media, not a passive information gap.

activation_trace.role: The absent distinguishing mark anchors the expanded evidence deficit in the focus phrase.
The repeated entwined verbal contest identifies the later figure with the focus behavior.
Repeated absence of disclosed knowledge forms the first missing guide.
Direction toward road and truth forms the second missing guide.
Ordered writing forms the durable third medium that the disputant lacks.
Illumination makes the book an exposing guide rather than inert text.
Turning the side in refusal gives bodily form to rejection of the three guides.
Causing departure from intended direction turns private lack into transmitted misguidance.
The extended traversable road supplies the orientation from which others are diverted.

structural_cues: 22:8 repeats the focus clause through بغير علم and then adds two coordinated negations.
22:9 continues the same singular figure with a body posture and causative misguidance.
The sequence moves from absent cognition to bodily orientation to social effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated clause, a stacked evidence deficit, bodily turning, and causative diversion; I infer that the deficit has become active refusal and exportable direction. A live alternative is that the posture chiefly marks arrogance while the intent to mislead is an additional vice rather than the mechanism of the original dispute.

changed_reading.before: Without knowledge means simply not possessing enough facts.
changed_reading.after: It names a collapsed orientation stack: no disclosed recognition, no living direction, and no illuminating record; dispute fills the vacuum and turns that refusal outward onto others.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:46 relocates blindness from eyes to hearts within chests and pairs hearts that restrain ignorance with ears that understand and comply. The focus lack of knowledge is therefore not explained by unavailable signs alone; it can be an embodied interpretive organ failing to let perception constrain desire and action.

activation_trace.role: Human seeing, sensing, and hearing anchor the later organ contrast in the focus designation.
Absent disclosure is recast as failure of reception rather than mere scarcity of information.
The heart supplies the named inner organ that can reason or become blind.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance supplies the heart's required checking function.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception behavioral rather than merely acoustic.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the explicit diagnosis of inner nonrecognition.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the intact faculty contrasted with inner blindness.
The chest as source from which acts issue locates epistemic failure upstream of conduct.

structural_cues: The contrast explicitly negates blindness of the eyes and affirms blindness of hearts.
Travel through the land is linked by purpose to acquiring reasoning hearts and hearing ears.
The focus ayah already coordinates deficient knowing with following behavior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intact eyes, blind hearts, reasoning as restraint, and hearing as compliance; I infer that the focus disputant's lack is a failed constraint between perception and action. A live alternative is that travel is illustrative evidence gathering and not a general anatomy of every no-knowledge dispute.

changed_reading.after: The deeper failure is internal uptake: available sights and sounds do not become heart-level restraint, so argument can coexist with abundant evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:52-54 presents an adversarial information process: shaytan casts into an aspiration or recitative channel, God removes what is cast and consolidates the signs, and the same event separates diseased or hardened hearts from those given knowledge whose hearts settle. The focus person's following can thus occur at the uptake stage, before injected material is distinguished from what has been made firm.

activation_trace.role: Tracing an item step by step anchors following as an uptake process rather than only social allegiance.
The rebellious agent recurs as the explicit source of inserted material.
Recitation placed in its positions supplies a live channel reading alongside the branch's broader field of inward aspiration.
Casting something down supplies the injection operation.
Removal followed by replacement supplies active deletion of the injected material.
Making firm and tightly ordered supplies consolidation of the signs after deletion.
Testing metal or person supplies the sorting function assigned to the insertion event.
Loss of heart-softness supplies one receiver condition under which the insertion becomes a trial.
Disclosure to those given knowledge supplies successful discrimination of the consolidated truth.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what knowledgeable receivers recognize.
A low, calm, open tract supplies the heart's settled receptive posture after recognition.
Direction toward road and truth supplies the successful output of the filtering process.

structural_cues: 22:52 gives an ordered cast-remove-firm sequence.
22:53-54 assign opposed receiver outcomes to the same event.
The focus roots ش ط ن and ع ل م recur on opposite sides of the filtering process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a casting source, deletion, consolidation, testing, and opposed heart responses; I infer an adversarial insertion-and-filter mechanism and place focus following at uncritical uptake. A live alternative is that تمنى foregrounds aspiration rather than recitation, but either scope still retains insertion into a humanly active channel followed by correction.

changed_reading.before: Following a shaytan means knowingly choosing an obviously rebellious leader.
changed_reading.after: Following can be epistemically subtle: an alien contribution enters an active channel, and the decisive failure is accepting it before truth is distinguished and made firm by knowledge and a receptive heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:67-70 places ritual plurality beside mutual pulling and renewed jidal, then answers with invitation from straight guidance, acknowledgment that God knows deeds, divine judgment over difference, and a comprehensive book. The focus fault is not speech as such but using argumentative braiding to seize adjudicative authority while lacking the knowledge and record that could sustain it.

activation_trace.role: Tight verbal braiding anchors the counterbraiding that the later response declines to continue.
Distinct worship practice supplies the concrete domain in which contest arises.
Mutual pulling between sides supplies a force model for the dispute.
Direction toward truth supplies the speaker's warranted location without requiring argumentative ownership of judgment.
Straightness and balance qualify that guidance as an aligned route.
The focus contest recurs explicitly, allowing the prescribed response to revise the baseline.
Divine knowing of deeds supplies the knowledge claim to which the dispute is deferred.
Judgment between people supplies adjudication outside the disputants' verbal contest.
Each side taking a different road supplies the live plurality that judgment will separate.
The written record supplies durable total context unavailable to the no-knowledge disputant.

structural_cues: 22:67-70 forms a continuous sequence from ritual difference to dispute, response, judgment, knowledge, and record.
The response in 22:68 is brief rather than a mirrored counterargument.
God's knowledge and judgment repeatedly occupy roles the disputants might claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ritual difference, mutual pulling, straight guidance, a restrained reply, judgment, and record; I infer a discipline of refusing adjudicative capture by debate. A live alternative is that الله أعلم is reassurance about outcome rather than a general rhetorical method.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns argument about God categorically.
changed_reading.after: It condemns argument that usurps judgment without epistemic standing; the alternative is to remain on disclosed direction, invite, and leave final separation to knowledge and judgment larger than the contest.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:71-73 links worship without revealed authority or knowledge to hostile facial recognition of clear signs, near assault on their reciters, and a parable in which called objects cannot recover a tiny loss and both seeker and sought are weak. The focus dispute can function as compensatory defense around a powerless dependency relation whose claimant and liability cannot deliver protection.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit and demand for a claim anchor the later seeker-sought relation in the focus following.
Attached liability supplies the cost hidden inside the dependency.
A compelling proof or authority is explicitly absent from the worship relation.
The repeated absence of disclosed knowledge directly recalls the focus deficit.
Visible signs supply the evidence against which the dependency is defensively maintained.
Recognition by a trace or mark shows that the signs register even as they are rejected.
Denial as the opposite of recognition supplies the hostile conversion of perceived evidence.
Near enactment supplies the transition from facial rejection toward assault.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the dependency's appeal toward the followed object.
Failed extraction from another's grasp supplies the followed object's inability to protect or recover.
The opposite of strength supplies the shared condition of both sides of the relation.
Seeking and the thing sought form the paired dependency whose two poles are declared weak.

structural_cues: 22:71 repeats the no-knowledge formula while adding absent revealed authority.
22:72 moves from clear recitation to visible denial and near physical assault.
22:73 ends with the balanced active-passive pair الطالب والمطلوب after a failed recovery scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unsupported worship, registered yet rejected signs, near aggression, failed recovery, and a weak seeker-sought pair; I infer that dispute defends a dependency whose object cannot secure it. A live alternative is that 22:71-73 addresses called objects broadly, so its application to every focus shaytan is analogical rather than referentially identical.

changed_reading.before: The follower is weak because a stronger rebel dominates him.
changed_reading.after: Follower and followed can form a jointly weak dependency: because the object cannot protect or recover, argument and aggression compensate for the relation's lack of authority and efficacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes by denying constrictive entanglement in religion, commanding a protective holdfast to God, and naming one patron and helper. This revises the tether baseline: the alternative to following every long-cord rebel is not unattached autonomy, but a nonproliferating attachment whose function is preservation rather than dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting anchors the focus's proliferating material entanglement.
The long strongly twisted cord supplies the adverse tether contrasted with the closing holdfast.
Every and whole supplies proliferating allegiance across all adverse tethers.
Gathering and entanglement supply the constrictive condition explicitly denied in the religious path.
The worshiped object is also the explicit object of protective holding, unifying direction and attachment.
A strap or fastening grasped for support supplies the alternative tether whose purpose is protection.
Love, aid, and patronage name the single legitimate relational center.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the holdfast's protective outcome.

structural_cues: 22:78 is the surah's closing ayah.
The command واعتصموا بالله is immediately followed by هو مولاكم and paired praise of patron and helper.
The focus has one follower distributed across كل شيطان, whereas the closure gives one object of holding and one patron.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus cord branches, denied constriction, protective fastening, one patron, and aid; I infer two competing attachment regimes. A live alternative is that اعتصام denotes protective adherence without activating a material cord image.

changed_reading.before: The problem is attachment itself, so freedom would mean following no one.
changed_reading.after: The problem is dispersed, nonprotective attachment to every remote force; the closure answers with one protective holdfast and one patron that preserves agency by orienting it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates literal cord branches rather than the ordinary abstract senses of dispute and shaytan. It remains anchored in the focus's tight twisting, long cord, and following roots, while 22:15 supplies extension, a cord-connection, cutting, stratagem, and inward rage. Downstream prose should present it only as a material systems analogy, not as a lexical translation of either ayah or a claim about the scene's historical procedure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ج د ل B001, ت ب ع B001, and ش ط ن B002 jointly expose a braided cord along which following can move.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the argumentative braid.
Following behind supplies travel of influence along the braid.
The long strongly twisted cord makes the material cross-activation packet-internal.
Drawing something lengthwise until connected supplies cord extension.
A cord and connection supplies the explicit material link.
Severing supplies the attempted interruption of the circuit.
Stratagem supplies the engineered attempt to control the tether's outcome.
Constricted rage in the chest supplies the pressure that remains after the attempted cut.

changed_reading.before: The disputant uses argument, then separately follows a shaytan.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, argument braids and extends the adverse connection; reactive attempts to manipulate or cut that circuit do not by themselves remove the inward pressure that powers it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because 22:31 describes a falling associator, not the focus disputant, and maps plural following onto a spatial dynamics scene. It remains validly anchored in كُلَّ, following, and the shaytan branch of distance; the context supplies falling, snatching, airborne force, and a remote endpoint. Downstream prose should mark it as an analogy for distributed agency loss, not identify the bird or wind with a shaytan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍ combines trailing, exhaustive plurality, and distance.

activation_trace.role: Trailing supplies motion governed by what is ahead.
Exhaustive inclusion supplies multiple simultaneous candidate vectors.
Distance and severance supply the vectors' common outward result.
Noisy unstable falling supplies initial loss of self-directed footing.
Swift snatching supplies capture by an external vector.
Released rash motion supplies one unpredictable carrier.
Descent into an abyss supplies irreversible downward displacement.
Wind as force and dominance supplies a second impersonal carrier.
Extreme distance supplies the endpoint shared by competing vectors.

changed_reading.before: Following every shaytan means repeatedly choosing many bad leaders.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, 'every' depicts distributed capture: competing external vectors do not enlarge choice but abolish a stable trajectory, carrying the subject toward a shared remoteness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most branch-distant reading: it activates مَرِيد through its polished-building branch and places it beside 22:45's ruined settlement, disabled well, and raised plastered palace. It remains anchored because the focus also lacks the distinguishing mark carried by ع ل م, so smoothness can function as a surface resistant to diagnostic grip. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for persuasive facade, never as the lexical meaning of مريد in the focus.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَّرِيدٍ B002 supplies a polished smooth structure, while بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ lacks the mark by which a surface could be diagnostically distinguished.

activation_trace.role: A tall polished smooth structure supplies the seductive low-grip facade.
The absent distinguishing mark supplies inability to diagnose the polished surface.
Vacancy and emptiness supply the condition hidden behind impressive elevation.
The well supplies essential life-supporting infrastructure.
Emptied disuse supplies failure of that infrastructure.
An enclosed monumental building supplies the surviving facade.
Raised and plaster-strengthened construction supplies the facade's conspicuous finish.

changed_reading.before: Mārid only intensifies the shaytan's moral rebellion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the followed rebel can also present as a polished explanatory facade: smooth argumentative elevation remains impressive while the underlying well of knowledge and inhabitable order is empty.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequel turns following into delegated guidance under a written adverse trajectory.
The repeated dispute formula expands no knowledge into absence of knowledge, guidance, and illuminating record, then gives that refusal bodily and social direction.
The heart-blindness passage relocates the failure from unavailable evidence to failed embodied uptake.
The cast-remove-firm sequence makes satanic following an adversarial insertion and receiver-filter problem.
The closing holdfast contrasts dispersed attachment to every remote force with one protective patronal attachment.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence preserved explicit epistemic mechanisms while activating unusually coherent material ones: braid, cord, cutting, distributed falling, and polished facade all remained anchored in focus roots rather than becoming independent themes.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordination of يجادل and يتبع supports one mechanism but does not grammatically prove that argument causes following rather than accompanying it.
The agency and emphasis within تولاه can be distributed differently between chosen allegiance and acquired patronal control.
The scope of تمنى in 22:52 between aspiration and recitative activity changes the exact insertion channel without removing the cast-correct-firm sequence.
The rope, falling-vector, and polished-facade models are controlled analogies and should not displace the ordinary lexical readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Argument as tightly twisted entanglement.** `ج د ل B002` directly supplies contentious disputation, while `B001` supplies firm twisting and interlacing; `ت ب ع` assigns movement behind another, and `م ر د B003` hardened defiance stripped of good. The disputant's speech and following are sequentially coupled. I infer that unaided contention twists the speaker into the path of what he follows. The verse thus reads not only as an intellectual error but as argument becoming an entangling mode of allegiance.
2. **Bare defiance disguised as inquiry.** `م ر د B001` gives stripping bare of covering and `B003` hardened defiance; these stand after *without knowledge*. I infer that the absence of knowledge removes the legitimate covering from the debate and exposes its driving posture. The debate consequently reads as inquiry in form but uncovered rebellion in function.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:52-54 later supplied a repair model for contested speech: adversarial casting is removed, signs are firmed, and knowledge lowers hearts rather than tightening dispute.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Disputation as a twisted counter-sequence.** Fixed `يُجَٰدِل` activates `ج د ل:B001` (firm twisting and interlacing) together with `B002` (contentious disputation), while `يَتَّبِع` admits `ت ب ع:B003` (stepwise tracking). `22:5` presents an ordered chain of material stages and `22:6-7` draw conclusions from it. The packet supplies the ordered evidence and the following; I infer that argument without knowledge twists those links into a rival track. The ayah reads as a malformed method of sequence-building, not merely loud disagreement.
2. **Following as progressive remoteness.** Fixed `شَيْطَان` activates `ش ط ن:B001` (distance and remoteness) and `مَّرِيد` activates `م ر د:B003` (hardened defiance stripped of good). `22:4` supplies the resulting direction toward misguidance and blaze. I infer that allegiance to hardened remoteness reproduces distance at each step. The follower is therefore not passively deceived once; the chosen guide makes estrangement into a trajectory.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:5-7` unexpectedly turned the later material sequence into a control case for `ج د ل:B001`: the fixed disputant's “following” became a twisted rival sequence rather than generic imitation.

baseline.text: İnsanlardan kimi bilgisizce Allah hakkında tartışır ve her asi şeytana uyar.

findings.text: Bilgisiz tartışma, kanıtları düzenlemek yerine onları birbirine dolayan ve tartışanı izlediği yola bağlayan bir yöntem olur.
Şeytana adım adım uymak, katılaşmış başkaldırıyı giderek artan bir uzaklaşma güzergâhına dönüştürür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Argument and allegiance acquire the mechanics of ropework, while spiritual instability becomes bodily posture and a failed strangling or cutting operation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısındaki insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ve tek bir üyesini birlikte gösterir. Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insan türünü ve onun tekil ya da toplu üyelerini kapsar; yakınlık duygusunu, duyusal algıyı ve insana dönük yanı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında yer alan insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ya da tek bir üyesini belirtir. İnsanların görünür oluşu, bu adlandırma için aktarılan bir gerekçedir.

facets.statement: İnsan türünü, insanların oluşturduğu topluluğu veya bu türün tek bir üyesini görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında adlandırır.
Adlandırmanın insanların duyularla görünür oluşuna bağlanması, anlamın özü değil kökene ilişkin bir açıklamadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, dalın insan türünü hem topluluk hem tek kişi olarak gösterebildiğinde ve görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfıyla karşıtlık kurduğunda birleşir. Görünürlük, ortak anlamdan çok adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak sunulur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanı hem tür hem bu türün üyesi olarak gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yer değiştirme yalnız insanı genel olarak adlandıran bağlamlarda mümkündür. Odak dalın görünmeyen varlıklarla sınıf karşıtlığı, komşunun ise görünür beden yönü kendi sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız insan türünü ve bu türün tekil ya da toplu üyelerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yeryüzündeki bütün yaratılmışları kapsayabilir ve bazı yorumlarda insanlarla görünmeyen varlıkları birlikte içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insan türü ile bütün yaratılmışlar ayrımı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsanlar iki dalın gönderim alanında da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşunun genel yaratılmışlar kapsamı odak dala taşınamaz; odak dal da yalnız insanları belirttiği için bütün yaratılmışların yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insan türünü ve bu türün üyelerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını, yakınlık ve rahatlık oluşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insan adı ile yakınlık duygusu ayrımı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da insan, temel gönderim noktası veya deneyim sahibi olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Birinde insanın kim olduğu adlandırılır, diğerinde bir kişi ya da şey karşısındaki duygusal durum anlatılır; sıradan bağlamlarda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı. Yalnız insanı adlandırma sınırını yaratılmışlar kapsamından ve yakınlık duygusundan ayıran, okuyucu için en yararlı üç karşıtlık yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإنس والبشر والناس والأناسي والإنسان من حيث الجماعة أو الواحد، وما بالدار أنيس بمعنى أحد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل مجرد الاستئناس النفسي ولا الإيناس بمعنى الإبصار ولا الجانب الإنسي إلا بدليل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنس خلاف الجن وسموا لظهورهم (maqayis;mufradat)؛ الإنس البشر والواحد إنسي والجمع أناسي (sihah)؛ الإنس جماعة الناس والأناسي جماع (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görmeyi temel alır, fakat belirli kullanımlarda işitmeyi, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etmeyi ve çevreye bakarak birini aramayı da aynı dalda aktarır. Bu yüzden dal genel ve sınırsız bir algı yetisi diye tanımlanamaz; her uzantı kendi bağlamına bağlı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duyusal olarak fark etmeyi ve belirtilen bağlamlardaki işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma kullanımlarını kapsar; yakınlık ve rahatlık duygusunu kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Görüp fark etme çekirdeği ile ses işitme, olgunluk belirtisini ayırt etme ve çevreye bakıp araştırma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplardaki kapsam çıplak biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görüp fark etmeyi anlatır. Belirli kullanımlarda bir sesi işitmeye, bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini ya da kaygı veren bir durumu sezmeye ve çevreye bakarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını araştırmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
Belirli bir ses nesnesiyle kullanıldığında o sesi işitmeyi anlatır.
Bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini bilip ayırt etmeyi veya kaygı veren bir durumu duyularla sezmeyi anlatabilir.
Çevreye bakıp dikkatle araştırarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarılan anlam alanının merkezi görüp fark etmektir. Aynı ifade ailesi belirli nesne ve yapılarda işitme, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etme, kaygı veren şeyi sezme ve bakıp araştırma yönlerinde kullanılır; bunlar sınırsız bir genel algı anlamı oluşturmaz.

concept_gloss.text: görerek fark etme; bağlama göre işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görme çekirdeğiyle birlikte yalnız belirtilen bağlamlarda ortaya çıkan işitme, sezme ve çevreyi araştırma uzantılarını topluca verir.

error_profile.preserves: Görme çekirdeğini ve bağlama bağlı üç algısal uzantıyı ayrı olduklarını belirterek korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin gözle seçildiği veya görüldüğü temel kullanımda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözle görme ve görüleni fark etme işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesne açıkça bir ses olduğunda kullanılan bağlama bağlı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin kulakla algılanması biçimindeki özel kullanımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsedeki olgunluk veya kaygı uyandıran durum gibi bir belirtinin ayırt edildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal belirtiden bir durumun varlığını anlayıp ayırt etmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çevreyi gözleyip birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkatle bakma ile birini bulmaya yönelik araştırmayı birlikte korur.

ürken yabani hayvanın birini sezip çevreye bakınması
çevreye bakıp birinin olup olmadığını araştırmak

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişi veya şeye yönelen deneyim fikrini çok genel biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Görme, işitme, belirtiyi sezme ve çevreye bakıp araştırma işlemlerini siler.
error_profile.adds: Zamanla gelişen yakınlık ve yabancılığın kalkması anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yakınlık ve rahatlık bildiren ayrı dalla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, görmenin yanında belirli yapılarda işitme, belirti sezme ve çevreyi araştırma uzantılarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal göz organını, görme duyusunu ve göz açıp dikkatle bakma eylemini kendi başına kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: fark etme ile gözle görme ayrımı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi göz yoluyla görüp seçme alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yalnız görsel algı bağlamında yakın karşılık olabilirler. Odak dalın işitme ve belirtiyi sezme uzantıları komşuya, komşunun göz organı anlamı da odak dala taşınamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal görmeyi merkez alır ve yalnız belirli söz çevrelerinde işitme, sezme ve araştırmaya uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir duyu aracılığıyla algılama, bilme ve varlığını saptama alanını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: belirli algı kullanımları ile genel duyumsama
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir şeyin duyular aracılığıyla fark edilmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha genel bir duyu alanıdır; odak dalın uzantıları ise kanıtlanan nesne ve yapılara bağlıdır. Bu nedenle genel duyumsama her durumda odak ifadeyle karşılanamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir nesneyi görme, işitme veya belirtilerinden sezme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duymayıp yakınlık hissetmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: duyusal fark etme ile yakınlık hissetme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişi veya şeyle karşılaşma iki anlam alanının ortak başlangıç durumu olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algısal saptamayı, komşu dal ise karşılaşma sonrasındaki duygusal rahatlığı bildirir. Algı gerçekleşebilir ama yakınlık doğmayabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar değerlendirildi. Görme, genel duyumsama ve yakınlık duygusuyla karışma olasılığı en yüksek üç sınır yayımlandı; diğer adaylar dalı açıklayan ek bir karşıtlık sağlamadı.
branches.branch_image_ar: إيناس الشيء برؤية أو إحساس أو سماع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الأنس بمعنى الراحة والمؤالفة ولا الإنس بمعنى البشر إلا بقرينة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: آنست الشيء إذا رأيته وآنسته إذا سمعته (maqayis)؛ آنسته أبصرته وآنست الصوت سمعته وآنست منه رشدا علمته (sihah)؛ آنس من جانب يعني أبصر نارا والاستئناس النظر وأحس بما رابه (tahdhib)؛ فإن آنستم منهم رشدا أي أبصرتم وآنست نارا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişi veya şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Yakınlık ve sevinç, rahatlık veren kişi ya da şey ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvan kullanımları bu çekirdekten bağımlı biçimde açıklanabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duygusal yakınlık, rahatlık ve bunları sağlayan varlıkları kapsar; insan türünün adı, duyusal fark etme ve insana bakan yan anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yabancılık duymama çekirdeği ile rahatlık veren kişi veya şey ve insana alışık hayvan gibi özelleşmiş biçimler ayrı katmanlarda tutulur; özel biçimler bütün dalı tanımlamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık, ürkme veya kaçınma duymayıp yakınlık, rahatlık ve sevinç hissetmeyi anlatır. Bu duyguyu veren kişi veya şeye ve insana alışık, saldırgan olmayan hayvana da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkıp yakınlık, rahatlık veya sevinç oluşmasını anlatır.
Kişiye arkadaşlık ederek veya yanında bulunarak yabancılık duygusunu gideren kişi ya da şeyi adlandırır.
İnsana alışık ve saldırgan olmayan hayvanı, özellikle bu nitelikteki köpeği anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yabancılık ve kaçınmanın karşıtı olan yakınlık ve rahatlıktır. Bu durum birine alışıp onun yanında sevinmeyi, rahatlık veren kişi veya şeyi ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvanı kapsayacak biçimde genişler.

concept_gloss.text: yabancılık duymadan yakınlık ve rahatlık hissetme
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin ürkütücü ve yabancı gelmemesi, tersine yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi anlatıldığında dalın çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yabancılığın kalkmasıyla oluşan yakınlık ve rahatlık bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya şey karşısındaki yabancılık duygusunun kalktığı temel durumda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alışma sonucunda yabancılığın kalkmasını ve yakınlık oluşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: yanında rahatlık veren kişi veya şey
contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızlığı veya ürkmeyi gideren bir arkadaş, nesne ya da başka bir dayanak adlandırıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık ve güven veren kaynağın kişiyle sınırlı olmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsandan kaçmayan ve ısırıp saldırmayan evcil ya da alışkın hayvan için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın insana alışıklığını ve saldırgan olmama sınırını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yabancılık ve ürkmenin kalkmasıyla oluşan yakınlık ve rahatlığı, ayrıca bunu sağlayan varlığı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişi, yer veya şeye alışmayı, ona bağlanmayı, onunla sürekli bulunmayı ve hayvanın evcilleşmesini daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişi, yer, şey veya hayvana karşı yabancılığın azalmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın belirleyici yönü yabancılık ve ürkmenin karşıtı olan iç rahatlığıdır; komşu dal süreklilik, bağlanma ve alışkanlık yönlerini odaktan daha geniş taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişi dışındaki şeylerin verdiği rahatlığı ve insana alışık hayvanı da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal seçilmiş kişiler arasındaki arı, özel ve karşılıklı dostluk bağını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: rahatlık veren yakınlık ile özel dostluk
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişiler arasında yakınlık ve içtenlik bulunan durumlarda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Her rahatlık veren yakınlık özel ve arı bir dostluk değildir. Komşunun karşılıklı dostluk sınırı odak dalın nesne ve hayvan uzantılarına uygulanamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yabancılığın kalkmasıyla doğan duygusal yakınlığı ve rahatlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan türünü, insan topluluğunu veya bu türden tek bir kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yakınlık durumu ile insan adı ayrımı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan, iki dalda da temel katılımcı veya gönderim noktasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir duygusal ilişkiyi, komşu dal ise bir varlık sınıfını adlandırır. İnsan olmak yakınlık hissetmeyi gerektirmez ve iki ifade birbirinin yerine geçmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı. Alışıp bağlanma, özel dostluk ve insan türünü adlandırma alanları dal sınırını en açık gösterdiği için yalnız bu üç ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنس بمعنى البشر ولا الإيناس بمعنى الإبصار ولا الجانب الإنسي إلا بدليل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأنس أنس الإنسان بالشيء إذا لم يستوحش منه (maqayis)؛ الإيناس خلاف الإيحاش والإنس خلاف الوحشة والأنيس المؤانس وكل ما يؤنس به (sihah)؛ أنست بفلان أي فرحت به والأنس والاستئناس هو التأنس وكلب أنوس نقيض العقور (tahdhib)؛ الأنس خلاف النفور ولكل ما يؤنس به (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya bakan yanını belirtir; salt sol, salt sağ, genel ön taraf ya da insanın kendisi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yönü, ona yaklaşan veya onu kullanan insana göre belirlendiğinde dalın ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Yanı sabit sağ veya sola bağlamadan insana göre yönelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın binme ve sağma sırasında insana yakın kalan yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanını biniciyle kurduğu işlevsel ilişkiye göre belirler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın kullanım sırasında okçuya doğru dönük olan yüzü belirtilirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yay yüzünün yönünü okçunun konumuna göre belirleme özelliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyin insana bakan veya en yakın olan yanı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir nesnenin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük yanını ilişkiye göre belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak ön, önde, yakın veya karşıda bulunma yönlerini kişiye bağlı bir kullanım ilişkisi gerektirmeden anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insana dönük yan ile genel ön taraf
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin bakana göre karşıda veya önde kalan bölümünü gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yön, insanın nesneyle kurduğu konum veya kullanım ilişkisine bağlıdır. Komşu dalın genel ön ve yakın anlamları bu özel bağı gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yönelme tamamlandıktan sonra insana dönük olan sabit yanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yüz, baş, el, kap veya hayvanın bir hedefe doğru dönmesi ve yönelmesi eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişi veya hedefe doğru bakma yönünü içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bir nesnenin insana dönük yanı bir bölüm adıdır; komşu ise dönme veya yönelme olayını anlatır. Sonuç konumu ile o konuma geçiş eylemi birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insana veya kullanıcıya yakın ve ona bakan yanı gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنسي الأيسر من كل شيء وقيل الأيمن وما أقبل منهما على الإنسان فهو إنسي وإنسي القوس ما أقبل عليك منها (sihah)؛ الإنسي من الدواب الجانب الأيسر الذي منه يركب ويحتلب ومن الإنسان الجانب الذي يلي الرجل الأخرى (tahdhib)؛ إنسي الدابة للجانب الذي يلي الراكب وإنسي القوس للجانب الذي يقبل على الرامي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntüyü, ayrıca ayrı bir aktarım olarak parmak ucunu kapsar; gözün kendisini veya genel insan türünü belirtmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen söz kuruluşlarında kişinin kendisini veya seçkin yakınını gösterir; genel insan, gerçek evlatlık ve her türlü arkadaşlık anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli sözlerde kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta gösterilen soru ve kişi bağlantısı kuruluşlarını topluca açıklarken kullanılabilir; genel bir kişi ya da akraba adı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendisi ile onun seçilmiş yakını arasındaki iki ayrı gönderimi ve kuruluş sınırlamasını korur.
